zh-CN.title: QQ 历史身份可以认领了
items: 已获授权的空间会在账号与安全中显示 QQ 身份绑定入口
验证数字 QQ 邮箱后，迁移的历史说说和评论会归入当前账号
迁移自 QQ 空间的说说和评论现在可以还原原始动态表情

en.title: Claim your historical QQ identity
items: Eligible spaces now show QQ identity binding under Account & security
Verify the numeric QQ mailbox to bring migrated posts and comments into your account
Posts and comments migrated from QZone can now restore their original animated emoticons
